item: The vitals history: memory, drive, database and log counts over days, in the Diagnostics zip (R119)
summary: A recorder on the session ledger's 5 s liveness tick keeps 5-minute buckets for 48 h and hourly rows for 14 d (min, mean, max and count of RSS, available memory, swap, Python blocks, threads, drive free, database, log and columnar sizes), the last 60 minutes with the three busiest threads, hourly log counts by logger and level, the tails of the last three sessions, and every clock step; a reading that could not be taken is null, never zero; flushed every 5 minutes and at a clean end; served as vitals.json (at most 260 KB, sized above the test's fixture) and GET /api/diagnostics/vitals-history; 132 mutants killed
